properties.area_description: Areas of Pernem, bardez, Bicholim, Tiswasi, Mormugao
properties.warning_message: Moderate to heavy rainfall with strong surface winds with speed gusting to 40-50 kmph is very likely to occur at a few places over talukas of Pernem, Bardez, Tiswadi, Ponda, Bicholim, Mormugao, Quepem, Salcette and nearby talukas of North Goa, South Goa for next 2-3 hours.
